stem.text: A source of sound waves is travelling as shown.
In which situation would the stationary observer detect the largest decrease in the observed frequency?

A.alt: Dot labelled observer and dot labelled source, with a leftward arrow labelled 5 m s-1 beside the source.

B.alt: Dot labelled observer and dot labelled source, with a leftward arrow labelled 10 m s-1 beside the source.

C.alt: Dot labelled observer and dot labelled source, with a rightward arrow labelled 5 m s-1 beside the source.

D.alt: Dot labelled observer and dot labelled source, with a rightward arrow labelled 10 m s-1 beside the source.
